scope: Read-only reconciliation of M520 capture timeout, cleanup, and outcome boundary

runnerContract.timeoutBehavior: After 30000ms the runner calls child.kill() and immediately rejects; it does not await the child's exit, does not assemble partial stdout/stderr, and does not write a receipt.
runnerContract.cleanupGap: Kill/exit disposition and buffered trace are not captured in the timeout path, leaving session/lifecycle outcome uncertified.

sessionBoundary.preWritePersistence: App persists the applying session before invoking typed detach; session state can therefore outlive a timed-out child even when project bytes remain unchanged.
sessionBoundary.conclusion: UNKNOWN for the M520 window because no capture receipt or session reread was produced; do not infer absence of session mutation from persistent project state.

testGap.currentCoverage: Synthetic nonzero child, exact target validation, and Windows CLI entry detection are covered; timeout cleanup/partial receipt behavior is not covered.
testGap.nextCorrection: Code-only timeout hardening must retain bounded partial trace, write a BLOCKED timeout receipt, record kill disposition, await exact-child exit with bounded grace, and add deterministic timeout tests.

validation.nextBoundary: M522 code-only capture-runner timeout hardening and deterministic timeout coverage
